sprint_goal: Deliver foundational data quality framework enabling automated profiling, configurable rule validation, and real-time alerting integrated with Databricks, Snowflake, and Airflow.

tasks.title: Develop automated profiling pipelines for new data sources
tasks.description: Create Airflow DAGs that trigger Great Expectations profiling on new Databricks/Snowflake datasets, capturing completeness and uniqueness metrics automatically.

tasks.title: Implement YAML-based rule configuration parser
tasks.description: Enable users to define quality validation rules in YAML and integrate parser with Great Expectations configuration, supporting all five quality dimensions.

tasks.title: Integrate real-time alerting via Slack and PagerDuty
tasks.description: Develop alerting module to send grouped and severity-filtered notifications to Slack and PagerDuty for failed quality checks above defined thresholds.

tasks.title: Design and implement data quality score dashboard
tasks.description: Create dashboards showing domain-level quality scores across completeness, accuracy, timeliness, consistency, and uniqueness using Databricks visualizations or BI tool.

tasks.title: Develop self-healing workflows for common failure patterns
tasks.description: Build Airflow jobs that automatically remediate missing partitions, fill NULLs, or rerun failed validation tasks when detect patterns match predefined rules.

tasks.title: Expose quality metrics in Atlan/DataHub catalogs
tasks.description: Integrate metric push mechanism to catalog APIs to display latest data quality indicators beside dataset metadata, ensuring governance visibility.

tasks.title: Create runbooks for top 20 failure scenarios
tasks.description: Document troubleshooting steps, remediation workflows, and escalation guidelines for common data quality issues in confluence or internal knowledge base.

tasks.title: Functional and performance testing of validation pipelines
tasks.description: Test data quality jobs for accuracy, coverage, and ensure runtime overhead is below 10% versus baseline pipeline execution times.

tasks.title: Implement Airflow metrics and logging enhancements
tasks.description: Add structured logging for validation results, remediation actions, and alert triggers; configure monitoring dashboards for execution traces.

risks.description: Alert fatigue due to excessive notifications across 50+ critical tables.
risks.mitigation: Implement severity-based grouping and domain-level throttling in alerting system.

risks.description: Performance degradation if validation checks exceed 10% runtime overhead.
risks.mitigation: Optimize parallelism and apply caching strategies in Great Expectations validation tasks.

risks.description: Integration complexity with existing Databricks/Snowflake pipelines.
risks.mitigation: Schedule validations in asynchronous Airflow tasks and leverage existing data connectors.

risks.description: Incomplete rule coverage across business domains during initial rollout.
risks.mitigation: Prioritize top 10 critical tables per domain and expand coverage iteratively post-sprint.

risks.description: Insufficient documentation could slow remediation of detected issues.
risks.mitigation: Develop detailed runbooks and escalation workflows as part of sprint deliverable.

definition_of_done: Automated data profiling runs successfully on new data sources.
YAML-based rule configurations executed by Great Expectations.
Real-time alerts triggered and grouped correctly by severity and domain.
Dashboard shows accurate domain-level data quality metrics.
Self-healing workflows validated for at least two failure patterns.
Quality metrics published in Atlan/DataHub catalogs.
All tests pass and runtime overhead remains below 10%.
Runbooks completed for 20 common data failure scenarios.
